options.why: Award is final with no appeal; court fee refunded.

sources.title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 — s.21
sources.snippet: Section 21: Every award of the Lok Adalat shall be deemed to be a decree of a civil court and shall be final and binding, with no appeal.

sources.title: Patil Automation Pvt. Ltd. v. Rakheja Engineers Pvt. Ltd.
sources.snippet: Section 12A of the Commercial Courts Act, 2015 is mandatory and a commercial suit instituted without exhausting pre-institution mediation must be rejected under Order VII Rule 11 CPC.
